name: test-plan
title: Beta test plan
for_each: select id,code from programmes order by code

sections.title: Activities
sections.sql: select code,name,instructions,due_on from activities where programme_id=$1 order by due_on,code

sections.title: Participant readiness
sections.sql: select participant,name,platform,eligible from v_cohort where programme_id=$1 order by participant

name: triage-brief
title: Beta feedback triage brief
for_each: select id,code from programmes order by code

sections.title: Feedback to review
sections.sql: select code,title,kind,severity,status,owner,fix_version from v_feedback where programme_id=$1 and status not in ('closed','duplicate') order by code

sections.title: Fix evidence
sections.sql: select f.code,r.tester,r.build,r.outcome,r.evidence_ref,r.tested_on from retests r join feedback f on f.id=r.feedback_id where f.programme_id=$1 order by f.code,r.created_at

name: exit-review
title: Beta exit review
for_each: select id,code from programmes order by code

sections.title: Current readiness
sections.note: An internal decision aid. It does not release software or certify product safety.

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.note: Historical snapshots. New feedback or changed evidence can invalidate an earlier decision.
sections.sql: select decision,actor,rationale,snapshot,created_at from decisions where programme_id=$1 order by created_at
